name: DockerUISP
description: This is an all-in-one Docker image for running the Ubiquiti Network Management System. This image contains all the components required to run UISP in a single container and uses the s6-overlay for process management. The Docker image, nico640/docker-unms, is not maintained by or affiliated with Ubiquiti Networks. You should not expect any support from Ubiquiti when running UISP (formerly UNMS) using this image. In-app upgrades will not work. You can upgrade UISP by downloading the latest version of this image.
